senses.gloss: Ar.) (m. pl.?) f. (baccar, baccaris; βάκχαρις = ἄσαρον; v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Asaron, Löw Pfl. p. 370) baccar, an aromatic plant supposed to be hazelwort or spike-nard.
